articles.title: Seedream 5.0 Pro on AI Gateway: Creative Model Routing
articles.exc: ByteDance's design-focused image model now shares routing infrastructure with text generation and orchestration tools.
articles.summary: Seedream 5.0 Pro arrived on Vercel AI Gateway on July 11, 2026, enabling architects and visualization artists to route design-grade image generation through the same endpoint as text and agentic tools. This unified creative pipeline streamlines paid-media production and complex multi-model workflows for architectural marketing and design assets.

articles.title: Seedream 5.0 Review: AI Image Model with Web Search
articles.exc: ByteDance's newest model combines real-time web search, logical reasoning, and vertical domain knowledge in architecture and science.
articles.summary: Launched in early 2026, Seedream 5.0 generates 2K and 4K images with real-time web search and domain expertise spanning architecture and geography—enabling archviz artists to create contextually accurate renderings with current design trends. The model prioritizes factual accuracy and complex reasoning over pure aesthetics, making it suited for technical visualization and location-specific architectural projects.

articles.title: Seedance 2.5: ByteDance's 30-Second AI Video Model
articles.exc: ByteDance announced native 30-second video generation with up to 50 multimodal reference inputs at its June 2026 conference.
articles.summary: Seedance 2.5's unified audio-video architecture and extended single-shot duration eliminate visible seams and lighting inconsistencies that plague stitched clips, making it viable for architectural walkthroughs and client presentations. The 50-reference-input capacity allows archviz teams to combine site photos, material samples, and lighting references in one generation pass.

articles.title: GitHub - ByteDance-Seed/SeedVR: Repo for SeedVR2 (ICLR2026) & SeedVR (CVPR2025 Highlight)
articles.exc: SeedVR2 accepted to ICLR 2026, a video restoration model addressing degradation and detail generation challenges.
articles.summary: SeedVR2's video restoration and upscaling capabilities are critical for archviz workflows that need to enhance AI-generated or low-resolution client footage to presentation quality. The model's tendency to oversharpening on 720p AIGC videos highlights texture control challenges relevant to material rendering accuracy.

articles.title: Top 15 AI Video Models 2026 for Architects & Designers
articles.exc: Kling 3.0 leads video generation models for architectural workflows with native 4K and extended duration capabilities.
articles.summary: The article benchmarks leading AI video generators specifically for architectural applications, ranking Kling 3.0 at 4.9 for consistency and visual quality. It covers reference-image workflows critical for maintaining design details and materials in client-facing architectural presentations.

articles.title: Kling 3.0: All-in-One AI Video Architecture Just Launched
articles.exc: Kuaishou's Kling 3.0 merges video generation, editing, and audio synthesis into a single unified workflow architecture.
articles.summary: Kling 3.0 represents a radical pipeline rebuild into a unified system handling generation, editing, and audio in one pass. For archviz artists juggling multiple tools to animate renders and add soundscapes, this consolidation could streamline presentation workflows significantly.

articles.title: From Nano Banana to Vision Banana: How Google DeepMind Turned an Image Generator into a Generalist Vision System
articles.exc: Google DeepMind researchers transformed Nano Banana Pro into Vision Banana, a unified generative model that handles segmentation, depth, and surface normals through prompt switching alone.
articles.summary: In April 2026, a team of 25 Google DeepMind researchers repurposed the Nano Banana Pro image generator for computer vision tasks—beating SAM 3 on segmentation and surpassing Depth Anything V3 on metric depth estimation, all without architectural changes. For archviz artists, this convergence means future tools could unify rendering, depth extraction, and object masking in a single generative workflow, eliminating task-specific pipelines.

articles.title: Veo 3 for Architecture: Free Prompts & How to Master Visual Design Videos
articles.exc: Veo 3 enables architects to transform design ideas into cinematic visual experiences through AI-powered video generation from text and image prompts.
articles.summary: Published December 2025, this guide demonstrates how architects use Veo 3's text-to-video capabilities to communicate spatial atmosphere and movement without building full 3D models or hiring animation teams. For visualization professionals, Veo 3's camera controls, lighting directives, and native audio offer a fast path from conceptual massing to client-ready presentation videos.

articles.title: Stable Diffusion 3.5: Complete Guide to Open-Source Image AI
articles.exc: Interior designers and architects use SD 3.5 for space concepts and material exploration with reliable prompt interpretation.
articles.summary: Stable Diffusion 3.5's Multimodal Diffusion Transformer architecture with three text encoders enables architects to generate architectural renderings and technical visualizations for communicating design intent. The model's strength in prompt interpretation makes it practical for interior design concept work and material exploration workflows.

articles.title: Top 5 Architectural Visualization Trends Dominating 2026
articles.exc: AI-assisted workflows in 2026 handle texture generation, denoising, and scene population so artists focus on design.
articles.summary: AI in architectural visualization has matured into a production tool that automates tedious tasks like texture generation and denoising, allowing human artists to focus on design and composition. Real-time rendering now simulates complex material interactions including reclaimed wood textures and sustainable design elements.

articles.title: Midjourney V7 for Architects: Create Stunning Renders
articles.exc: Midjourney V7 delivers photorealistic architectural renders in 2 minutes instead of 48 hours, transforming visualization practice.
articles.summary: Released in late 2025, Midjourney V7 offers 10x faster and 20x cheaper rendering than traditional 3D workflows. According to January 2026 AIA data, 62% of U.S. architecture firms now use generative AI in their design process, with V7's improved understanding of architectural vocabulary driving unprecedented productivity gains.

articles.title: 45 Midjourney Architecture Prompts (2026)
articles.exc: Copy-paste ready V7 prompts targeting buildings, facades, massing, and client presentations with exact materials and parameters.
articles.summary: This practical guide provides architects with production-ready Midjourney V7 prompts for exterior concepts, site context, and presentation work. It positions Midjourney as the ideation spark at the front of the workflow, best used for early-stage atmosphere and exterior exploration before moving to BIM and traditional rendering tools.

articles.title: How Adobe thinks creatives will use AI in 2026 – from Firefly to Project Graph
articles.exc: Adobe integrates third-party AI models like Runway and Flux while Firefly Image Model 4 renders architectural elements with exceptional precision.
articles.summary: Firefly now renders architectural elements with photorealistic accuracy, while new Project Graph enables node-based custom workflows connecting AI models and Adobe tools. Firefly Boards provides collaborative moodboarding for teams to iterate concepts, essential for archviz pre-visualization.

articles.title: A Designer's Guide to 2025's AI Tools: Midjourney, Firefly, and Beyond
articles.exc: Firefly's Generative Fill and Expand in Photoshop allow designers to add, remove, or extend architectural renderings non-destructively.
articles.summary: Deep integration into Photoshop, Illustrator, and InDesign makes Firefly essential for architectural workflows, with Generative Fill enabling rapid background extension and element replacement. Commercially safe training on Adobe Stock provides legal indemnification crucial for professional archviz studios.

articles.title: Best Image to 3D Models on HuggingFace (2026)
articles.exc: HuggingFace now hosts production-ready AI models generating PBR assets from images in under a second.
articles.summary: TRELLIS.2-4B and Hunyuan3D 2.1 lead the ecosystem for generating production-grade PBR materials with high-fidelity textures. These open-source models enable architects to convert concept images into workflow-ready 3D assets with physically accurate materials—no per-generation costs or cloud lock-in.

articles.title: Hunyuan3D 2.5: Towards High-Fidelity 3D Assets Generation with Ultimate Details
articles.exc: Tencent's 10B-parameter model generates sharp geometry and PBR textures via multi-view diffusion architecture.
articles.summary: Hunyuan3D 2.5 introduces LATTICE foundation model for detailed shape generation and upgraded PBR texture synthesis, closing the gap between AI-generated and handcrafted assets. For archviz workflows, this enables rapid creation of furniture, fixtures, and environmental props with professional-grade materials and mesh quality.

articles.title: Best AI for Interior Design in 2026 (14 Tools Tested)
articles.exc: July 2026 hands-on comparison of 14 AI interior design tools including MeltFlex, Spacely AI, Foyr Neo, and HomeDesigns AI.
articles.summary: Independent testing shows that MeltFlex leads for integrated floor-plan-to-purchase workflows, while Spacely AI now offers the most generous free tier for archviz professionals who need selective control and watermark-free commercial-use renders. The article evaluates each tool on AI-driven redesign capability, commercial-use rights, and output quality on challenging real-world room layouts.

articles.title: Top AI Tools Transforming Architectural Design Workflows in 2026
articles.exc: Survey data from 800 architecture professionals shows 64% now use AI tools, with 74% planning to expand usage within 12 months.
articles.summary: Chaos and Architizer 2025 survey reveals that rendering tasks now run in under 10 minutes versus 4–8 hours previously, but satisfaction drops to just 30% for later-stage deliverables requiring geometric precision. The guide matches specific AI platforms to workflow phases—concept, site analysis, rendering, and BIM automation—and highlights the integration gaps still limiting professional adoption.
